routeIdeas.title: Fiscalini Ranch Bluff Trail
routeIdeas.distance: 0.9-mile trail; outing length to be chosen
routeIdeas.description: Ocean air, handcrafted benches, and room to slow down. A coastal walk that leaves plenty of space for a conversation with your neighbors.

routeIdeas.title: Montaña de Oro Bluff Trail
routeIdeas.description: A little salt in the air and the Pacific beside the path. A chance to take in the coast, stretch your legs, and enjoy being outside together.
